description: This Java class implements PayPal payment processing, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund, using PayPal API SDKs. It handles PayPal express checkout flow, manages API credentials, and processes payment details for an e-commerce system.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements payment processing via PayPal, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund, integrating with PayPal API SDKs.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the necessary API credentials (api, username, signature) are provided in the configuration.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Method not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Processes an authorization transaction using a PayPal payment token.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates a PayPal express checkout transaction, setting up payment details, redirect URLs, and initiating the PayPal API call to get a checkout token.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in a single step using a PayPal payment token.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund (full or partial) for a PayPal transaction using transaction ID.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the core logic for executing a PayPal express checkout payment, including retrieving checkout details, executing payment, and recording transaction info.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction, finalizing the payment.
